author: The Linux Foundation
description: Mimi Zohar and Shuah Khan will talk about Mimi’s experience as a kernel developer and maintainer, taking questions from the attendees. Mimi will share what works and what doesn’t for her and strategies, interpersonal and technical skills and mindset that help her stay engaged for a longer term.
title: LF Live Maintainer Session: My Life as a Linux Kernel Developer and Maintainer with Mimi Zohar
